sections.title: RAPID OPS COMPANY
sections.body:
*Semper Primus.* Always first.

ROC is a BRM5 faction built around one idea: be the faction other factions call.

When a unit needs an enemy for their operation, we show up as the enemy. When they need a rescue, a reinforcement or an extraction, we get there first. In between we run our own operations, PvE and PvP.

"Company" is the echelon, not a corporation. ROC is not a PMC.

fields.name: OPFOR
fields.value: Another faction plans an operation and needs someone to fight. We field the opposition and play it straight. A real fight, no stalling, no ego, and nobody wrecks their event.

fields.name: QRF and SAR
fields.value: Quick reaction and search and rescue. A team is pinned, downed or cut off and needs bodies on the ground fast. Speed is the whole point.

fields.name: Our own operations
fields.value: PvE and PvP, posted in <#1542215046820663346> with RSVP buttons on the card. Anyone verified can sign up.

fields.name: Academy
fields.value: Planned. A training wing for players new to BRM5, once there are enough of us to staff it.

sections.title: HOW WE RUN
sections.body:
**Semi-milsim.** Structured enough that other factions trust us inside their operations, open enough that you do not need a resume to get in.

In practice that means: show up when you said you would, listen to whoever is running the op, use your mic, and take the mission seriously while it is running. Outside an operation this is a normal Discord server.

No application, no assessment, no attendance quota. Verification takes about a minute in <#1542256936161124412>.

sections.title: WHERE TO NEXT
sections.body: **Units** for where you fit. **Chain of command** for how you move up. **Work with ROC** if you are here from another faction.
